name: vivid-mcp
description: Your VIVID content studio inside Claude: product photos, videos, music, voices and timelines from the chat.
long_description: Connects your VIVID account (vividai.tv) to Claude Desktop. Ask for product photos, vertical videos, jingles, voice-overs, retouches, transcriptions, cuts to the beat and MP4 renders; the assets land in your VIVID gallery. Uses your plan's credits — nothing extra to buy. Paste your API key from vividai.tv → Settings → API key.

api_key.title: VIVID API key
api_key.description: vividai.tv → Settings → API key (starts with vk_). Rotate it there to disconnect.
